issues.issue: Did the officer reasonably assess the evidence of farm management experience?
issues.applicant_position: Officer unduly discounted his Ontario farmland experience and his Chinese company experience as farm management.
issues.respondent_position: Decision reasonable; applicant lacked two one-year periods of farm management; he merely disagrees with the assessment.
issues.result_quote: When reviewed as a whole, I find the Officer’s treatment of the evidence to be reasonable.

issues.applicant_position: Officer gave no reasons for rejecting his business experience, so it is impossible to understand why it was rejected.
issues.respondent_position: Reasons adequate and readily understandable; the decision letter and GCMS notes explain the statutory shortfall.
issues.result_quote: I find that it justifies the Officer’s Decision.
